    - heading "What is Amazon MSK?" [level=2]
    - paragraph:
      - text: Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK) is a streaming data service that manages Apache Kafka infrastructure and operations, making it easier for developers and DevOps / platform engineers to run Apache Kafka on AWS without becoming experts in operating Apache Kafka. Amazon MSK operates, maintains, and scales Apache Kafka clusters, provides enterprise-grade security features out of the box, and has built-in AWS integrations that accelerate development of streaming data applications.
